Let willing allies within 5 squares drop Prone, then roll Fortitude to deal poison damage to each other creature within 5 squares that is still upright.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Fortitude
Target / range / shape
Self; each willing ally within 5 squares; then each non-prone creature within 5 squares other than you.
Duration
Immediate.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once on your turn.
Type
Signature

Each willing ally within 5 squares may immediately fall prone. Make one Fortitude roll. Each non-prone creature within 5 squares other than you takes poison damage: Weak: 1; Standard: 2; Strong: 4.
